rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the living turkey bird.

example.english: The turkey on the farm is very big.
example.traditional: 農場入面嗰隻火雞好大隻。
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 go2 zek3 fo2 gai1 hou2 daai6 zek3

rows.note: Use this when you mean turkey meat eaten as food rather than the bird.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 sik6 fo2 gai1 juk6
